roadmap_scope: README Phase 13: Final Testing, Bug Fixes, and Project Stability

checks.details: Stage 1–6 focused suite passed; tests use temporary fixtures for writable state.
Full unittest discovery passed. Expected mocked Stage 1 database-lock logging and a Starlette/httpx deprecation warning appeared.
The project venv reports No module named pytest; no package was installed. The full unittest suite was run successfully instead.
Shared resolver selected V2 at threshold 0.53; metadata contract has 34 ordered distinct features; event_id, step, and isFraud are excluded; no promotion manifest exists.

Automated Stage 1 temporary-batch inference and Stage 5 shared-resolver tests passed, including /health model/threshold assertions and rejection of isFraud as request input. No live HTTP, Kafka, or Spark process was started.

Automated tests passed for synthetic label exclusion, conflict auditing, synthetic-only drift not requesting retraining, request deduplication, and insufficient eligible labels blocking candidate creation. Monitoring tests used temporary databases.

Temporary-artifact tests passed for authorization binding, fail-closed malformed/hash-mismatched manifest handling, dry-run, activation, rollback, stale approval rejection, and demonstration candidate rejection.

Using only a temporary copy of the artifacts, the resolver rejected a missing V2 model, malformed model JSON, and malformed activation manifest. A direct health check returned V2/0.53 and TransactionRequest rejected isFraud.

Unit tests trained toy demonstration candidates only in temporary directories and verified they remain ineligible for promotion. Existing Stage 6 candidate directories were inspected read-only and remain marked candidate_trained_not_promoted.

Pre/post SHA-256 snapshots matched for 495 local files: Stage 2/3 SQLite, WAL/SHM, checkpoints, V1/V2 artifacts, and prediction JSONL. Existing Phase 12 artifact hash baseline also matches the current V1/V2 model, metadata, and threshold files.
The persistent Stage 3 monitor, live API, Kafka broker, Spark consumer, and producer were not executed to avoid modifying persistent or external service state.
